description: Project scaffold + pure, framework-free learning logic and content catalog as ES modules, plus Node-runnable Vitest unit tests. This is the deterministic core that mirrors the Android 'domain' layer (no DOM/browser globals). Independent of the UI feature that follows — everything here is testable with `npm test` alone.
steps: Create repo scaffold at /projects/sandbox/naukaweb: package.json with { "private": true, "type": "module", scripts: { "test": "vitest run", "test:watch": "vitest" } } and devDependency vitest (latest 2.x). Run `npm install`.

Create docs/js/logic/models.js exporting shared constants/helpers ported from ReviewState.kt and LearningModule.kt: LEARNING_MODULES = { COLORS:'COLORS', POLISH_LETTERS:'POLISH_LETTERS', NUMBERS:'NUMBERS', ENGLISH:'ENGLISH' }; LEITNER boxes 1..5 with FIRST=1, LAST=5, and ofLevel(level) clamping to 1..5; a factory createReviewState(itemId) returning { itemId, box:1, dueTimestampMillis:0, lastReviewedMillis:null, correctStreak:0 }.

Create docs/js/logic/content.js exporting the content catalog, values EXACTLY matching app/src/main/java/com/kidsedu/app/domain/content/ContentCatalog.kt. colors: 10 items czerwony #FF0000, niebieski #0000FF, zielony #008000, żółty #FFEB00, pomarańczowy #FF7F00, fioletowy #8000FF, różowy #FF69B4, brązowy #8B4513, czarny #000000, biały #FFFFFF (id 'color_<name>', prompt=answer=name, colorHex, audioKey 'audio_color_<name>'). polishLetters: 32 letters with the exact example words and emoji as in ContentCatalog.kt (A arbuz 🍉, Ą wąż 🐍, B balon 🎈, C cebula 🧅, Ć ćma 🦋, D dom 🏠, E ekran 📺, Ę gęś 🦢, F flaga 🚩, G gitara 🎸, H hulajnoga 🛴, I igła 🪡, J jabłko 🍎, K kot 🐱, L lampa 💡, Ł łódka 🚤, M mysz 🐭, N nos 👃, Ń koń 🐴, O oko 👁️, Ó ósemka 8️⃣, P pies 🐶, R ryba 🐟, S słońce ☀️, Ś ślimak 🐌, T tygrys 🐯, U ul 🐝, W woda 💧, Y ryba 🐟, Z zebra 🦓, Ź źrebak 🐴, Ż żaba 🐸); id 'letter_<lowercase>', prompt=answer=letter, emoji, exampleWord, audioKey 'audio_letter_<lowercase>'. numbers: 0-9 with Polish words zero,jeden,dwa,trzy,cztery,pięć,sześć,siedem,osiem,dziewięć; id 'number_<digit>', prompt=digit string, answer=word, emoji=digit string, audioKey 'audio_number_<digit>'. englishWords: the exact 24 pairs from ContentCatalog.kt (cat/kot 🐱 ... house/dom 🏠); id 'english_<word>', prompt=word, answer=polish, emoji, audioKey 'audio_english_<word>'. Also export allItems and itemsFor(module).

Create docs/js/logic/srs.js porting SpacedRepetitionScheduler.kt: DEFAULT_INTERVALS_DAYS = {1:1,2:2,3:4,4:7,5:15}; MILLIS_PER_DAY = 86400000; intervalDays(box), intervalMillis(box); schedule(state, correct, now) => new state where correct promotes box (min(box+1,5)), increments correctStreak, sets lastReviewedMillis=now and dueTimestampMillis=now+intervalMillis(nextBox); wrong sets box=1, correctStreak=0, lastReviewedMillis=now, dueTimestampMillis=now+intervalMillis(1). dueItems(states, now) returns states with dueTimestampMillis<=now sorted by dueTimestampMillis, then box, then itemId. Make schedule pure (return new object, do not mutate input). Allow an optional intervals override arg for testability but default to DEFAULT_INTERVALS_DAYS.

Create docs/js/logic/gamification.js porting Gamification.kt: constants BASE_POINTS_PER_CORRECT=10, STREAK_BONUS_PER_STEP=2, MAX_STREAK_BONUS=20, POLYGLOT_TARGET=10, WEEK_STREAK_DAYS=7, MASTERED_BOX=5. awardForAnswer(correct, currentStreak) => wrong: {pointsAwarded:0, newStreak:0}; correct: bonus = clamp(currentStreak*STREAK_BONUS_PER_STEP, 0, MAX_STREAK_BONUS), {pointsAwarded: 10+bonus, newStreak: currentStreak+1}. starsForLesson(correct,total) => 0 if total<=0 or correct<=0 else ratio>=0.9?3:ratio>=0.7?2:1. Export BADGES array with {id,title,description} using exact Polish titles: first_steps 'Pierwsze Kroki', color_master 'Mistrz Kolorów', letter_master 'Mistrz Liter', number_master 'Mistrz Cyfr', polyglot 'Poliglota', week_of_learning 'Tydzień Nauki'. evaluateBadges(snapshot) returns array of newly-earned badges (excluding snapshot.alreadyEarnedBadgeIds) per the same rules: first_steps when totalCorrectAnswers>=1; color/letter/number master when completedItemsByModule[module]>=totalItemsByModule[module] (and total>0); polyglot when englishWordsMastered>=10; week_of_learning when reviewStreakDays>=7.

Create docs/js/logic/streak.js porting ReviewStreak.kt: MILLIS_PER_DAY=86400000; epochDayOf(nowMillis)=Math.floor(nowMillis/MILLIS_PER_DAY); onReview(previous, todayEpochDay) with previous={currentStreakDays,lastReviewEpochDay}: last==null->1; today==last->max(current,1); today==last+1->current+1; else->1; returns {currentStreakDays, lastReviewEpochDay: todayEpochDay}.

Create tests/srs.test.js: assert correct answer promotes box and lengthens interval, box never exceeds 5 after repeated correct, wrong answer resets to box 1 and resets streak, dueTimestamp = now + interval for the resulting box, dueItems filters dueTimestamp<=now and orders most-overdue-first with box then itemId tie-breaks, and a multi-round simulation converges to box 5. Assertions must be tight enough to fail if the interval table or promote/demote logic were changed.

Create tests/gamification.test.js: assert 10 points for first correct (streak 0), streak bonus growth (streak 1 -> 12, streak 5 -> 20, and cap at 20 for streak 10+), wrong answer yields 0 points and streak 0 (never negative), star thresholds at 90%/70%/>0/0, and evaluateBadges earns each badge exactly when its rule is met and never re-earns an alreadyEarned badge.
Create tests/streak.test.js: assert first review -> 1, same-day review unchanged, next-day -> +1, a 2+ day gap resets to 1, and reaching 7 consecutive days yields currentStreakDays===7.
Run `npm test` and confirm all specs pass.
acceptance_criteria: `npm install` succeeds and `npm test` runs Vitest with all logic tests passing.
content.js exposes all 4 modules with exact counts: 10 colors, 32 Polish letters (all 9 diacritics ą ć ę ł ń ó ś ź ż present), 10 numbers, 24 English words, matching ContentCatalog.kt values and ids.
srs.js, gamification.js, streak.js contain no DOM/browser globals and are importable in Node (proven by the tests running under Vitest).
SRS intervals are exactly {1:1,2:2,3:4,4:7,5:15} days; gamification constants are exactly 10 / 2 / 20 / 10(polyglot) / 7(week); mastered box is 5.
verification: Run `npm test` from /projects/sandbox/naukaweb and confirm all Vitest suites pass.
Confirm test count covers scheduler promotion/demotion/cap/due-ordering, gamification points/bonus-cap/stars/badges, and streak same-day/next-day/gap/7-day cases.
findings: Scaffolded package.json (type:module, test:vitest run, test:watch; devDependency vitest ^2.1.9) and ran npm install (91 packages). Ported the pure domain layer to ES modules under docs/js/logic/: models.js (LEARNING_MODULES, LEITNER 1..5 with ofLevel clamp, createReviewState), content.js (values copied verbatim from ContentCatalog.kt: 10 colors with exact hex, 32 Polish letters incl. all 9 diacritics ą ć ę ł ń ó ś ź ż with exact example words + emoji, 10 numbers with Polish words, 24 English/Polish pairs; same id + audioKey schemes; plus allItems and itemsFor), srs.js (DEFAULT_INTERVALS_DAYS {1:1,2:2,3:4,4:7,5:15}, MILLIS_PER_DAY, intervalDays/intervalMillis, pure schedule with promote cap at 5 and box-1 reset on wrong, dueItems filter+sort by dueTimestamp/box/itemId, optional intervals override), gamification.js (BASE 10 / STEP 2 / MAX 20 / POLYGLOT 10 / WEEK 7 / MASTERED_BOX 5, awardForAnswer with clamped bonus, starsForLesson 90/70/>0, BADGES with exact Polish titles, evaluateBadges excluding already-earned; accepts Set or array), streak.js (epochDayOf floor-div, onReview null->1/same-day/next-day/gap rules). No DOM/browser globals. Added tests/{srs,gamification,streak}.test.js. Verified: npm test => 3 files, 35 tests all passing; and a Node import sanity check confirmed counts 10/32/10/24, all 9 diacritics present, id scheme (color_czerwony, letter_ą, number_5, english_cat), and itemsFor mapping. Added .gitignore (node_modules) . Did NOT touch UI/persistence/speech/index.html/README per scope.
